summary: Frontend-only test of People Mode Events + Radar Hotspots. Radar chip and hotspot RENDER correctly (seeded Friday Drinks visible), Create Event FAB present, My Events (Hosting/Joined/Past) works, events privacy respected (no lat/lng in /api/events/nearby payload). BLOCKERS: (1) radar-events-chip OVERLAPS radar-radius-chip at 390px width — events chip stretches from left:12 to right:104 giving width=274px, fully covering the Radius chip beneath (regression vs. spec 'confirm it doesn't overlap Radius'). (2) Tapping radar-event-{id} does NOT open event-preview modal — hotspots render UNDER people markers (RadarView.tsx L561 comment), so overlapping avatars capture the tap; this blocks TEST 2/3/5/6/7/9 via testID selectors. Because of blocker #2 the full happy-path (preview→detail→join/leave, create, approval, host tools, report) could not be verified through UI selectors. React Native deprecation warnings observed but non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: eventsChip inherits left:12 from radiusChip and only sets right:104 → events chip is 274px wide at 390px viewport and fully OVERLAPS the Radius chip (x=12..286 vs radius x=12..153). Ref: /app/frontend/src/components/RadarView.tsx:876

Tapping the radar-event-{id} Pressable does NOT open the event-preview modal in web preview. Event hotspots are rendered UNDER people markers by design (RadarView.tsx L561 comment: 'rendered UNDER people markers so they never overwhelm them'), so when a person avatar overlaps the hotspot (very common with Focus Map + 500m radius) the tap falls through to the person marker and setEvPreview is never called. Reproduced via Playwright click on [data-testid=radar-event-...] — event-preview element remained absent while a person preview opened instead. Ref: /app/frontend/src/components/RadarView.tsx:561-579

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by hotspot z-order bug above — could not verify preview open, ev-preview-open button, event detail, join/leave, request-to-join, host tools, or report via UI. Backend /api/events/nearby returns hotspot correctly (verified) and /api/events/mine returns joined event; only the click surface is broken.

Ref: /app/frontend/src/components/RadarView.tsx (styles: blip, glow, me, eventDot, eventName, eventMeta, radiusChip, ctrlBtn, filtersBtn, privacyPill)

action_items: FIX events chip positioning so it doesn't overlap Radius: at 390px viewport radius chip ends at ~153px and filters starts at ~296px — position events chip in that gap. E.g. change styles.eventsChip in RadarView.tsx L876 to `{ left: 160, right: undefined, borderColor: colors.orange + '55' }` OR use `alignSelf: 'center'` with `top: 12`.

FIX hotspot tap capture: either render hotspots ABOVE people markers OR raise the Pressable's hitSlop, OR add a transparent overlay Pressable at the hotspot center that stops propagation. Simplest fix: move the events map block AFTER singles.map so events are painted last and receive taps.
After fixes, retest TESTS 2,3,5,6,7,9 (preview modal → detail → join/leave/request/withdraw, create event flow, host edit/cancel, approval accept/decline, report event).
Migrate deprecated RN Web shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: RadarView.tsx eventsChip style relies on cascade with radiusChip which sets left:12; explicit `left: undefined` doesn't remove the inherited left in StyleSheet.compose. Confirmed at runtime — bounding box shows x=12.

Event hotspot render order (L561-579) intentionally places events under people markers — this conflicts with the requirement that hotspot taps open the preview. Needs either z-index reordering or a dedicated tap capture layer.
Good: coord privacy is intact — /api/events/nearby response contains distance/bearing only, no lat/lng/latitude/longitude keys.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (chip overlap): StyleSheet composition applies both radiusChip and eventsChip — radiusChip sets left:12 and eventsChip only overrides right:104. Since `left: undefined` doesn't unset the inherited left in React Native StyleSheet flattening, the chip renders anchored at left:12 AND right:104 → width becomes screen_width - 12 - 104 = 274px on 390px viewport, sitting on top of the Radius chip. Repro: open radar on 390px viewport, observe Events chip covers Radius chip. Mitigation: set explicit left in eventsChip (e.g. left: 160) or use alignSelf/center positioning. Bug 2 (tap fallthrough): RadarView.tsx renders event MapAnchors BEFORE singles (people) MapAnchors in the same overlay layer, so people avatars paint on top. Playwright click on [data-testid=radar-event-...] hits the element's centre; when a person avatar shares that pixel, the person's Pressable (rendered later, higher z) receives the tap. Repro: with 58 nearby people + Friday Drinks in the same map region, click hotspot — person preview opens instead. Mitigation: swap render order so events render AFTER singles/clusters, OR add zIndex to event MapAnchor style, OR render a top-most transparent Pressable at each hotspot centre that calls onSelectEvent.
